question_text: Do you support the view that Jobs' parents and his teacher Imogene Hill contributed greatly to his education and his intellectual growth?
guide_solution: Yes, I think Job’s parents and his teacher played a vital role to his education and intellectual growth. His teacher inspired him very much. In the class of Hill, Jobs felt very special. His parents also took care of him properly. So all of them had a part in his success.

subject: English
question_text: What was the 'turning point' in Jobs’ life?
guide_solution: The turning point came was his meeting with his teacher Imogene Hill who watched him very closely and took special steps to handle him and get things done by him. In order to get things done she used to give him money and food. Her inspiration changed his life dramatically.
